text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- This year's tourist season in Ohrid will probably be poor; so far there are only 1,000 guests in Ohrid hotels.
- Macedonian Defense Minister Lazar Kitanovski will visit Russia on Wednesday. Macedonia has no intention of purchasing weapons from Russia.
- Life returns to normal on Tetovo streets and police presence has been significantly reduced. Gostivar court put on trial 21 participants of last Wednesday's demonstrations.
- Over 10,000 foreign tourists cross Tabanovce border crossing daily. waits at the border are several hours long.

- Debar municipal council decided not to take down the Albanian and Turkish flags in front of the town hall. A protest rally to be organised in neighbouring Albanian town of Peshkopea on Wednesday in protest against Macedonian police action last week.

- Miljaim Dauti died in Skopje hospital on Tuesday bringing to three the casualty toll of last week's Gostivar demonstrations. The ethnic Albanian DPA party announces new protests while PDP recommends removal of flags.

- The Democratic Party called on the state to prohibit activities of the ethnic Albanian DPA which directly jeopardise Macedonia's sovereignty and territory. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
